title: isodon coetsoides
intro: Isodon coetsoides, commonly known as "Himalayan isodon" or "Coets' isodon", is a species of flowering plant in the family Lamiaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used in Tibetan and Chinese medicine. The health benefits of Isodon coetsoides include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues, fever, and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Isodon coetsoides include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and diterpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects.
